name: Mantle
overview: The mantle in Scripture symbolizes both authority and deep emotional expression. Elijah's mantle, which Elisha took up after it fell from Elijah, represents the transfer of prophetic responsibility and God's power, as seen when Elisha parts the Jordan River using it (2 Kings 2:13-14). Conversely, the mantle is also rent as a tangible sign of grief and mourning, demonstrated by Job and Ezra who tore their mantles in sorrow and worship (Job 1:20; Ezra 9:3), and by Job's friends who rent their mantles and expressed lamentation (Job 2:12). Thus, the mantle serves as a powerful emblem of divine calling and human response to God's sovereign acts.
